measurement_notes: Text: 'Deconvolution of the spectra of PF4 obtained after the addition of 5 ug/mL 44mer-DNA protein C aptamer or 6.9 ug/mL heparin showed an increase in anti-parallel b sheet content from 24.2% to 34.3% for heparin and to 35.8% for the 44mer-DNA protein C aptamer. DISCREPANCY: Methods states PF4 at 40 ug/mL for CD; the Fig 5A legend states PF4 at 20 ug/mL.
